feedback: This is the final iteration, so no later race will use this feedback. I have delivered your iteration-10 geometry unchanged with the iteration-10 controller, which is the best-measured design (146.27). The evidence behind that: the 0.12 track with mass 0.75 and body_length 0.16 gave slalom line loss 0.0 and oval progress 0.597 (iteration 10). Narrowing to 0.10 was worse at every kp tried (iterations 6 to 8, 72.9 to 79.6), with slalom line loss up to 0.35 and oval progress halved. Lower inertia (mass 0.7, body_length 0.14, iteration 4) gave good progress but slalom line loss of 0.85. max_error stayed at 0.061 to 0.066 m across all nine races, so it is most likely the off-track threshold, not a geometry or gain lever. For this reason I did not add any further change. The unseen-track result will show whether this platform generalises. Any future work should treat the 0.12 track and midpoint inertia as the baseline, and test sensor span or forward offset only after a line-loss check.
